name: docs-wiki
description: Backlinks, search, link lint, and a local web UI over a repo's markdown. Plain files, no database, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs

//: Zero runtime dependencies, deliberately. No install or postinstall scripts, ever: installing this package must never run code. The published tarball ships a prebuilt dist/.
